paragraphs: itopia describes itself as an Educational Technology Management (ETM) company that puts the browser at the heart of the learning experience. The company groups its products into one platform for K-12 and higher education.

CloudApps replaces traditional computer labs with a virtual lab, and students can reach over 150 career and technical education applications from Chromebooks, Windows, and tablets. SecureClass gives K-12 schools control over digital learning in the browser and blocks unapproved artificial intelligence use, downloads, copy/paste, and unauthorized sharing. It runs as a Chrome extension across a district and enforces district policies inside the browser, including AI, extension, and data-sharing controls.

GoSprout covers work-based learning, listing internships, pre-apprenticeships, and youth apprenticeships as use cases. Itopia U covers training and enablement, delivered synchronous, asynchronous, or custom. Testimonials on the page name Chester Upland School District, Rancho High School Clark County School District, and Nevada Learning Academy.
